The product is browser-based: AI and algorithmic models analyse markets, surface signals and suggest entries, with automatic or manual execution. Registration is free, the demo runs alongside, and the minimum deposit sits at US$200.
Our method is a desk review: no funded account, no trades. We read the published material in full, including unfilled placeholders and contradictions, and scored five fixed dimensions.
whatItClaims: No prior trading experience required.
AI and algorithmic market analysis producing signals and suggested entries.
Automatic or manual execution, with a browser-based platform.
No platform fees - broker spreads and overnight charges still apply.
Payouts reportedly within a day.
whatWeChecked: The template marks: unfilled placeholders left in the wording.
The performance story: no verified track record behind the return claims.
The number reuse: one score figure doing more than one job.
The deposit terms: minimum amount, payment methods and where the money sits.
The demo claim: practice account confirmed in the signup flow.
The payout promise: within-a-day wording without processing detail.

pros: No platform fees on top of spreads.
cons: Asset list that shifts between pages.
The headline fee claim and the real cost disagree.
redFlags: The demo promised in the pitch but buried in the flow.
A score and a community mood wearing the same number.
Support figures that contradict each other.

faqs.q: Does it offer a demo account?
faqs.a: Yes - a practice account is part of the package and runs alongside the live balance, which is the sensible first step before risking the US$200 minimum.
The platform fee is absent, but every trade carries a broker spread the page itself calls the real cost. The headline says free; the fine print says otherwise. Budget for the fine print.
The page promises payouts within a day, but the processing detail is thin. Confirm the exact timeline and any fees with support before funding anything.

faqs.q: Is Delta Executors safe, legit or a scam?
faqs.a: We found no scam indicators in the product, which reads as a functioning AI trading service. The conditions are editorial: claims without verification, conflicting figures and restriction lists that disagree. We rate it safe to research with the conditions in this review.

faqs.q: What happens after I sign up?
faqs.a: You confirm the account by email, fund US$200, set your risk preferences and choose automatic or manual mode. The demo account runs alongside while you learn.

bottomLine: The desk, the demo and the funding options all check out. The score reflects the paperwork around them.
We rate it 4.5 with conditions: the platform is usable, the published claims are not all verifiable, and the US$200 minimum is the right size for testing either.
